Welcome to our Greensboro office! Reachable via Interstate 40, near Guilford College, our Greensboro location provides care for the Greensboro community as well as for patients traveling from the nearby neighborhoods such as High Point, Oak Ridge, Summerfield, and more. Therefore, we strive for our office and amenities to be designed with our patients’ health and well-being in mind. Situated in a suburban community that blends small-town charm with convenient access to the Friendly Center and Four Seasons Town Centre, this location is accessible and easy to travel to. Our Greensboro office stands out with its peaceful atmosphere, where patients feel supported and leave motivated to take care of their oral health with ease and comfort.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at Riccobene Associates in Greensboro, NC?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

Are you accepting new patients at your Greensboro dental office?

Yes. We are always happy to welcome new clients who are motivated to take care of their oral health! Please give us a call or schedule an appointment online. We can't wait to see you!

How do I schedule an appointment with a Greensboro dentist?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Do you provide emergency dental care in Greensboro, NC?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Clayton location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Is cosmetic dentistry, such as teeth whitening or veneers, available?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Can I get dental implants at the Greensboro office?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.
